method_wait_for_query: Wait for the method recording query to finish
method_import_first: Import an ART method recording first
method_select_thread_first: Select a thread before opening its call tree
method_additional_diagnostic_messages_om: additional diagnostic messages omitted by import cap; occurrence counts above remain complete.
method_additional_frames_omitted_from_th: Additional frames omitted from this preview:
method_header_start_is_not_added_to_even: Header start is not added to event times and does not establish a cross-artifact epoch. Self time is observed leaf duration; inclusive time sums invocation durations (recursion can exceed occupancy). Calls count ENTER records. Open frames stop at their own thread's last event; no tail is fabricated.
method_import_a_supported_local_art_arti: Import a supported local ART artifact to inspect method durations. Offline import only; capture transport and universal Android .trace compatibility remain unavailable.
method_integrity_diagnostics_are_present: Integrity diagnostics are present. Durations cover valid observed segments, not a certified complete recording.
method_intervals_are_returned_in_event_f: Intervals are returned in event-file order with original half-open boundaries. This is a bounded interval table, not a rendered/zoomable flame chart. Durations are not sample weights.
method_no_parser_replay_diagnostics_this: No parser/replay diagnostics. This still does not prove complete on-device capture or full format parity.
method_offline_local_input_bounded_metho: Offline, local, input-bounded method events — not Simpleperf CPU samples. No capture/device command is run and no file is uploaded. Close discards pending results; bounded work may finish in the background.
method_primary_unspecified_single_clock_: Primary = unspecified single clock (not assumed wall or CPU)
method_select_one_thread_to_inspect_its_: Select one thread to inspect its call tree. Top methods, events and timeline can include all threads. Diagnostics always include global parser messages and the selected thread's messages.
method_supported_existing_binary_first_s: Supported: existing binary-first SLOW v2/v3/v4/v5 fixture layouts. Conventional text-first Android .trace files and other producer variants are not supported; a .trace extension alone does not establish compatibility.
